d: Thousands of Haitians march through the streets of gang infested Port-au-Prince, to show their support for El Salvador's President, Nayib Bukele. Bukele's military operation in Haiti has managed to push back the gangs that have dominated the Caribbean nation for years. Firstpost takes a closer look at the new security pact between Haiti and El Salvador, which will allow Salvadoran troops to stay longer. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the situation on the ground in Haiti.
